messages:
maria: Quick Q for audit exports: customers asked we make it easy to trace "who changed a routing policy that later caused quota spikes". Right now the audit NDJSON has diffs but no quota context.
kevin: Yep. We only export the policy diff + routing table snapshot. Quota updates are in a separate telemetry stream so joins are annoying.
eli: Proposal: include a minimal quota hint on routing-change events: `quota_bucket`, `quota_scope`, `quota_delta_type` (increase/decrease). Keep it optional via export flag so small dumps stay compact.
sara: Console UX: show a tiny "affects quota" badge on the changecard and a permalink anchor to the rollout view. For legal/compliance they want a link from an exported event to the exact rollout stage.
maria: Also need `rollout_id` and `rollout_stage` in the export so auditors can see canary vs manual edit.
kevin: API schema concern: let's avoid breaking existing consumers. Option A: add common keys at top level (quota_bucket, rollout_id) and put vendor extras under `event_extras`. Option B: keep shape identical and deliver a companion sidecar file. Thoughts?
eli: I vote for top-level common keys. Most customers will search for just those. Extras can go in `event_extras` as a freeform map (for enterprise-only fields).
sara: From UX POV, we should also add `identity_mode` to the export config: values `pseudonymize|full|none`. Default to pseudonymize to avoid leaking emails. Exports should include `operator_id` and `actor_hint` rather than raw email unless `full` is selected.
maria: Good. Also add `policy_version` and `policy_preimage_hash` so downstream teams can verify exact rule content without embedding full policy text everywhere.
kevin: I'll draft a tiny RFC with sample NDJSON rows and a migration plan. Will include a SQL join snippet for SOC teams: how to join audit.exports -> quota.events by `event_id`.
sara: I'll make a simple console mock: changecard badge, anchor behavior, and an export settings toggle for identity_mode.
eli: I'll update the audit producer to emit `quota_hint` when a routing change triggers an immediate quota-affecting evaluation. Fallbacks: empty if unknown.
maria: Action list: kevin RFC, eli producer change, sara console mock + export UI, maria to coordinate QA. Aim to ship small change this week.
deploy-bot: deploy: audit-service v3.15.0 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-20T19:11:02Z :rocket:
kevin: RFC will include backwards compat notes and a sample NDJSON `event_id` mapping. Ping me if you want to pair on the RFC.
maria: Thanks everyone. If we can keep the export delta under ~5% size increase we're good.
